LanguageData.KSA.Section.alpha.Desc: The first sample area. On by default.
LanguageData.KSA.Section.beta.Desc: Exists only with Biotech. Off by default.
LanguageData.KSA.Section.gamma.Desc: Exists only with Combat Extended: shows the "needs X (not installed)" row.
LanguageData.KSA.Section.delta.Desc: A section with a removal step and a diagnosis line.
LanguageData.KSA.Setting.kit.windowScale.Desc: All windows of this mod grow or shrink by this factor (on top of the automatic size for large screens).
LanguageData.KSA.Setting.kit.verboseLog.Desc: Writes info and debug lines to the game log too (they always go to the mod's own log file). Only for hunting problems.
LanguageData.KSA.Setting.kit.showNerd.Desc: Shows the technical settings that most players never need.
LanguageData.KSA.Setting.kit.firstStartCard.Desc: Once per new colony (and once when the mod joins a save): a small card with the presets and a link to these settings.
LanguageData.KSA.Setting.ksa.count.Desc: Whole numbers from 0 to 20 on the slider, up to 1000 typed.
LanguageData.KSA.Setting.ksa.price.Desc: Whole silver; typed values stop at 10 × the silver stack limit.
LanguageData.KSA.Setting.ksa.uiPref.Desc: Global: the same in every save, shows the "all games" tag.
LanguageData.KSA.Compat.MissingSampleMod.What: Patch class Patch_MissingMod is applied only when this mod is active.
LanguageData.KSA.Compat.ImaginaryConflict.Why: Would fight over the same setting. Use only one of the two.
